question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off WebChat-to-last-external mirroring setting, fold this behavior into the broader origin-delivery policy, or keep Control UI delivery explicit-only?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the behavior intentionally crosses channel and privacy boundaries and overlaps a broader origin-delivery design, so code inspection cannot choose the product and security boundary.

options.title: Decide Under Origin-Delivery Policy
options.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat mirroring requirement while defining shared route freshness, authorization, and duplicate-delivery rules with the broader origin-delivery work.

options.title: Ship Narrow Default-Off Mirroring
options.body: Add the requested session config only if maintainers accept a separate WebChat mirroring policy and require live Discord or Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep Explicit Delivery Only
options.body: Close or defer this feature if maintainers decide WebChat should never reuse stored external routes without an explicit per-message delivery route.

recommendation.title: Decide Under Origin-Delivery Policy
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat mirroring requirement while defining shared route freshness, authorization, and duplicate-delivery rules with the broader origin-delivery work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current assignee and has already clarified adjacent routing scope in the linked discussion.
